description: Charge-off rate and dollar amount, aggregated by NAICS code, state, lender, or program. Answers "which industries have the highest SBA loan charge-off rate" or "charge-off amount by state". charge_off_rate is charged-off loan COUNT divided by total loan count in that group (not dollar-weighted).

group_by.description: One of: naics | state | lender | program (default naics).

naics_code.description: Optional 6-digit NAICS code to scope before grouping.

program.description: Optional: "7A" or "504" to scope before grouping.

state.description: Optional 2-letter borrower state code to scope before grouping.

name: sba_charge_off_aggregate
